note: v2131: The console carried a line telling him the mule manager lives in its own vault tab, and it sat inside a column that is hidden on the default sessions view at his own request, so it was born unreachable and measured zero by zero. The room has had a real labelled button in the header since v2092, visible on every view, so the hidden duplicate is removed rather than moved. Guarded both ways because deleting a sign is only safe while the door still exists.
